Clang before 19 leaves a constant offset from a global as a typed
getelementptr (a struct field by its index); later ones fold it into
bytes. xcheck only read the folded form, so xcheck_tool failed with
Clang 18. Such offsets are now folded into bytes before reading.

* fix(port): mix the sound ahead of the device so a late mix leaves no gap

On Windows the sound cut out in short, ugly gaps. SDL's WASAPI device
asks for sound every 10 ms, and the callback rendered the whole sound
engine right then, under the lock the game's thread takes for every
sound call. Any wait longer than the device's slack (the game's thread
holding the lock while preempted, the processor busy while the graphics
driver compiled) was a gap.

commits.author: mateuszklysz
commits.body:
Swimming on Pokitaru showed the rooms under the sea floor. The level's
baked visibility hides them from every water cell, but OpenGL never used
it, and Vulkan drew everything when the camera left the grid (deep water
has gaps). Retail keeps the last mask there.

Pvs::follow keeps the last mask outside the grid (everything before any
cell), and both backends now use the baked visibility.
